checkpoint_finding.interpretation: The base encoder is eligible for target-label evaluation but cannot be the released best openly licensed model because the checkpoint is noncommercial and share-alike. Reference sequence exposure must remain explicit.

known_incidents_and_biases: Nonoverlapping six-mer tokenization makes scores depend on the left boundary phase.
The pinned vocabulary has 4105 entries while the paper describes 4104.
The model is not reverse-complement equivariant.
The checkpoint config names an unrecovered Transformers 4.29.0 development build.
Published downstream eQTL work used presence or absence labels and does not validate signed, cell-type-specific effect prediction.
remaining_blockers: Keep the model restricted-comparator-only unless checkpoint terms change.
Register a nonsealed signed-effect development source before fitting common heads.
Recover the exact Transformers source revision or numerically validate a frozen compatible runtime.
Acquire only after campaign approval, verify SHA-256, and convert the PyTorch state dict to safetensors in a restricted no-network process.
Fixture-test six tokenization phases, reverse complements, vocabulary count, REF matching, and GRCh38-to-GRCh38.p14 contig behavior.
